highlights: Agents can ask with buttons, reply chips, lists and short forms, and you answer in the chat.
A new Tasks page shows the tasks of all agents by what they need, and you can send a task to any agent.
The full browser view has tabs in one row, and you can talk to the agent of a tab while you look at the page.
Settings > Profile shows the activity of this computer in the past year, and you can share an image of it.
A message no longer stays running after a failed turn, and the next messages in the queue start.
